validation.packedTypecheck: Fresh consumer passed strict TypeScript with root helper/types and explicit Box definition entry.

implementation: Shared structural base with nine explicit native templates and 77 ordered common style accessors
Canonical role and accessible naming reach one native semantic root; native ID reference properties resolve references in the author scope
Existing generated responsive renderer, style helper and breakpoint configuration are exported and used by the real Box
Manifest links explicitly annotated kebab-case attributes to their matching public getters; all 77 associations checked
CSS is authored in styles/shared and compiled; raw children retain parent and identity
reviewCorrections: Dynamic native tag templates fail the explicit dependency analyzer; nine literal templates preserve compile-time dependency verification
Happy DOM accepts invalid CSS grammar as supported; structured HTML parsing is asserted in native browsers, not inferred from its CSS.supports result
Element-reference inputs validate before state mutation; returned reference arrays are frozen and filtered by native scope
Playwright 1.63 role queries ignore ariaLabelledByElements, reproduced on a plain native section; Chromium native AX confirms both names correctly
limits: Firefox/WebKit checks prove native reference targets and lifecycle; native accessibility-tree snapshots here are Chromium only. No screen-reader speech certification is claimed.
Real layout geometry is verified for the named Box cases. Flex/Stack/Grid/Simple Grid/Group remain separate M07 entries.
Known Firefox late-definition-after-adoption and WebKit nested-slot container-query limits remain the existing E02/M26 records.
No React package implementation is claimed; the fresh consumer proves public type and HTML/Lit delivery.
